description: Database performance optimization - Add missing indexes on frequently queried columns (status, timestamps, foreign keys) across business_leads, companies, deals, contacts, activities, discovery_jobs, outreach_approvals, and conversations tables. Add pgvector ivfflat index for knowledge_chunks embedding similarity search.
steps: Create Alembic migration file using `alembic revision -m 'add_performance_indexes'` in backend/ directory

In the upgrade() function, add 15 CREATE INDEX statements covering: business_leads (status, source_provider, qualification_score, created_at), companies (status), deals (status, stage_id), contacts (company_id), activities (company_id), discovery_jobs (status, created_at), outreach_approvals (status), conversations (status, last_message_at), knowledge_chunks (vector index using ivfflat with 100 lists)
In the downgrade() function, add corresponding DROP INDEX statements for all 15 indexes
Test migration: Run `alembic upgrade head` in backend/ directory with postgres running
Verify indexes created: Connect to PostgreSQL and run `\d+ business_leads` to confirm indexes exist
Run backend test suite: `pytest tests/ -v` to ensure no regressions
Document the indexes in a new file backend/docs/DATABASE_INDEXES.md explaining each index purpose
acceptance_criteria: Alembic migration file created in backend/alembic/versions/ with unique revision ID
All 15 indexes successfully created when running `alembic upgrade head`
pgvector ivfflat index created on knowledge_chunks.embedding column
Migration is reversible - `alembic downgrade -1` removes all indexes
All existing pytest tests pass after migration
Query performance improvement measurable: SELECT with WHERE status= clause shows index usage in EXPLAIN ANALYZE
verification: cd backend && alembic upgrade head (should complete without errors)
docker exec -it crm_leads_postgres psql -U postgres -d crm_leads -c '\d+ business_leads' (shows indexes)
docker exec -it crm_leads_postgres psql -U postgres -d crm_leads -c 'EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM business_leads WHERE status = \'qualified\';' (shows Index Scan)
cd backend && pytest tests/ -v (all tests pass)
